findings.amount: misstatement in the ledger, base currency minor units, positive; duplicate_invoice: the AR debit of the later-issued copy; fx_error: abs(posted - correct); period_cutoff: the AR debit posted; payment_allocation: expected AR credit for the ref - AR credit posted
findings.evidence: doc_id / row_id / fx_id values; must include at least one full acceptable evidence set: duplicate_invoice: both invoice docs + one AR (or revenue) row of each invoice, the original and the later copy; payment_allocation: payment doc + invoice doc + the AR credit row of that invoice in the payment (or, if nothing was allocated to it, the 2900 row) + the invoice-date fx_id if foreign; fx_error: doc + AR/revenue (invoice) or cash (payment) row + the fx_id of the correct date; period_cutoff: invoice doc + AR (or revenue) row
findings.tolerance: abs(claimed - expected) <= tolerance_minor; tolerance_minor is 0, so the amount must be exact

fx.direction: rate = units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency (major units)
fx.rate_date: transaction date in the company timezone (invoice: issued_at; payment: timestamp)

ledger.currency: every ledger row is in base_currency
ledger.invoice: Dr 1200 / Cr 4000 at the invoice issue-date rate, only for invoices issued in the period
ledger.payment: Dr 1000 at the payment-date rate; Cr 1200 per invoice_ref at that invoice's issue-date rate; remainder (or all, if invoice_refs is null) Cr 2900 at the payment-date rate; difference to 7900; negative amount = refund: Dr 2900 at the payment-date rate of the receipt it returns (the same customer's latest earlier payment in that currency whose amount - sum of invoice_refs equals the refunded amount; the refund-date rate if there is none), Cr 1000 at the refund-date rate, difference to 7900

period.rule: a record belongs to the period iff its timestamp converted to the company timezone has a date in [start, end] (inclusive)
